actions.action: Move plant within 3 feet of brightest window
Give the pot a quarter turn weekly
Slide root ball out to check roots
If root-bound, repot into a pot 2 inches wider with potting soil and perlite
Fertilize at half strength every 4 weeks in spring and summer
Empty the outer pot 15 minutes after watering

reason: The answer calls the plant healthy and blames light, missing that several tangled money trees were stunting each other; it never suggests separating them, and its reassurance delays the needed fix.
